device.title: Extra Controls — {device_name}
device.description: Select which entities to expose for {device_name}. Only enable options your device supports — unsupported settings will be silently ignored by the appliance.

data_description.check_filter: Problem sensor that turns on when the filter state is CLEAN, CHANGE, or BUY. Use it to trigger filter-maintenance notifications.
data_description.bucket_status: Shows Full when the water bucket needs emptying and Empty otherwise. Dehumidifiers only — models that report no bucket signal show as unavailable.
data_description.filter_runtime: Cumulative air-filter runtime reported by the appliance in native seconds. Home Assistant converts it to the configured display unit.
data_description.compressor: Opt-in temperature-based estimate, not device telemetry. Adds a Compressor Estimate diagnostic sensor and refines hvac_action while enabled on appliances that do not report modeState.
data_description.cool_hysteresis: Temperature deadband around the setpoint used by the estimate. Zero disables the deadband.
data_description.compressor_off_delay: How long the room must remain below the lower deadband boundary before the estimate changes to idle.
